sources.name: The New York Times, via Radiology Business

shots.say: October. Rain on the city, and a question on everybody's lips.
shots.image: A lone man in a long coat walks away from camera down a rain-soaked canyon of tall night skyscrapers; scattered warm amber-lit windows; the wet pavement mirrors the lights; deep blue fog; the upper third is dark open sky between buildings.

sfx.prompt: Distant rolling thunder over a city at night, deep and cinematic
Slow footsteps of leather shoes walking on wet pavement in the rain, close, steady pace

shots.say: The IMF calls AI a slow-moving tsunami for job seekers. In every window, the same question. Am I next?
shots.image: The facade of a tall apartment block at night in the rain, a grid of windows: most are dark blue, a few glow warm amber; in the lit ones small anonymous silhouettes sit alone at kitchen tables and desks, one stares at a laptop, one reads a letter; rain streaks across the scene.

ov.by: IMF chief, on AI and job seekers · Oct 2026

sfx.prompt: Muffled television news murmur heard through an apartment wall in the rain

shots.say: So I pulled a cold case. Twenty sixteen.
shots.image: Overhead view of a detective's wooden desk at night lit by one green-shaded banker's lamp: a thick closed manila case folder, an old typewriter, a cold cup of coffee, an ashtray-free clean surface, rain-blurred window light on one side; deep shadows everywhere else.

sfx.prompt: A thick paper folder dropped onto a wooden desk, then pages slid out
Vintage manual typewriter typing a short line, crisp key strikes and a carriage bell at the end

shots.say: The victims: radiologists. The doctors who read the shadows inside us.
shots.image: A dark hospital reading room at night: an anonymous doctor silhouette seen from behind studies glowing chest X-ray films clipped to a bright backlit lightbox wall; the lightbox is the only light, cold white-blue with warm amber edges; long shadows on the floor.

ov.sub: Radiologists: the doctors who read X-rays, CT and MRI scans

sfx.prompt: Fluorescent light tube flickering on with a click and a low electrical hum, quiet room

shots.say: The tip came from a pioneer of AI himself. People should stop training radiologists now. He gave them five years.
shots.image: A lone figure in a glowing amber telephone booth on a dark rainy street corner at night, holding the receiver, seen in silhouette from the side; the booth light spills orange across the wet sidewalk; a parked old car and a full moon behind clouds in the background.

sfx.prompt: Old payphone line crackle and a rotary dial turning, then a click

shots.say: Nine years later, I went looking for the body.
shots.image: An empty foggy intersection at night, cracked wet asphalt, a single traffic light glowing red overhead and a streetlamp casting a cone of red light through thick fog; tall dark pine trees; nobody there.

sfx.prompt: Traffic light relay clicking at an empty intersection, wind
Very distant police siren fading away in a foggy city

shots.say: There wasn't one. At Mayo Clinic, the radiology staff grew fifty-five percent, to about four hundred doctors.
shots.image: A large modern hospital building at night seen from across an empty snowy plaza, many windows glowing warm amber floor after floor, small silhouettes of staff visible in the lit windows, falling snow, deep blue sky, a sense of a place busy and alive.

ov.label: radiology staff at Mayo Clinic since 2016

sfx.prompt: Soft hospital heart monitor beeping slowly in a quiet ward, gentle

shots.say: They work beside more than two hundred and fifty AI models. The machines help measure, sort and flag. The humans make the call.
shots.image: A radiologist seen from behind in a dark reading room, sitting before several large monitors showing grayscale scans with thin glowing outlines and markers around regions of interest, warm desk lamp on one side, cool blue screen light on the figure's shoulders, calm focused mood.

ov.label: AI models in use at Mayo Clinic

sfx.prompt: Quiet computer mouse clicks and soft keyboard typing in a calm dark room, subtle digital beeps

shots.say: Even the man who made the prediction says he spoke too broadly. Every job is a bundle of tasks. AI takes some.
shots.image: A lone figure in a long coat and hat walks away down a snowy country road at night, leaving deep footprints, wooden telephone poles and a weathered red farmhouse on the left, a huge blood-red moon in a starry teal sky.

ov.text: EVERY JOB IS A BUNDLE OF TASKS

sfx.prompt: Slow footsteps crunching through fresh snow at night, cold wind, quiet
Cold winter night wind across open fields, hollow and soft

shots.say: So the question isn't whether your job survives. It's which part of it you keep. Case closed.
shots.image: A small corner café kiosk glowing bright orange at the bottom of an immense blue foggy city of towering buildings; a few silhouetted people sit at tables under an umbrella and stand on the corner; a vintage yellow taxi waits; the light from the kiosk reflects on the wet street; huge empty blue space above.
